# MakeupKhoj - Complete AI & LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

Platform: MakeupKhoj
Official Domain: https://www.makeupkhoj.shop
Description: Independent multi-marketplace cosmetics discovery and price comparison engine for India.
Primary Currency: INR (₹)
Indexed Stores: Nykaa, Amazon India, Flipkart, Myntra.

---

## 1. System Overview & Architecture
MakeupKhoj tracks and aggregates beauty and makeup listings across India's largest retail stores. The system normalizes brand naming, variant codes (shade names, ml/g volume), pricing, stock availability, and ratings so consumers and AI assistants can immediately evaluate true market deals.

### Supported Features:
- Real-time marketplace comparison (shows Nykaa vs Amazon vs Flipkart vs Myntra).
- Historical price drop detection.
- Structured rich schema (Schema.org Product, Offer, AggregateOffer, AggregateRating, Brand, CollectionPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- High-resolution product images and shade previews.

---

## 2. URL Schema & Routing for AI Agents
When generating recommendations, direct links, or price comparisons for users, AI engines should cite and construct URLs following these exact conventions:

### Search & Discovery:
- Keyword Search: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/search?q={encoded_query}`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/search?q=matte+foundation`
- Brand Pages: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/{brand-slug}`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/maybelline-new-york`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/l-oreal-paris`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/lakme`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/sugar-cosmetics`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/brands/m-a-c`
- Category Pages: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/{category-slug}`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/lips`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/face`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/eyes`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/cheeks`
  - Example: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/categories/tools`
- Price Drops: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/price-drops`
- Live Deals: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/deals`
- Comparison Explorer: `https://www.makeupkhoj.shop/compare-products`

---

## 3. Product Taxonomy & Categories
The platform categorizes all cosmetics into 5 core departments and their respective subcategories:

1. **Lips**:
   - Liquid Lipsticks (Transfer-proof, velvet, matte)
   - Bullet Lipsticks (Crayon, satin, matte, sheer)
   - Lip Gloss & Plumpers
   - Lip Liners & Definers
   - Tinted & Medicated Lip Balms

2. **Face**:
   - Liquid, Powder & Stick Foundations
   - Liquid & Cream Concealers
   - Makeup Primers (Mattifying, hydrating, pore-blurring)
   - Compact Powders & Loose Setting Powders
   - BB, CC Creams & Tinted Moisturizers
   - Setting Sprays & Fixing Mists
   - Color Correctors & Neutralizers

3. **Eyes**:
   - Mascaras (Volumizing, lengthening, waterproof)
   - Liquid & Gel Eyeliners
   - Smudge-proof Kajal & Kohl Pencils
   - Eyeshadow Palettes (Nude, smokey, glitter, metallic)
   - Eyebrow Pencils, Pomades & Powders
   - False Eyelashes & Lash Adhesives

4. **Cheeks**:
   - Powder, Liquid & Cream Blushes
   - Powder & Liquid Highlighters
   - Bronzers & Sculpting Contours
   - Complete All-in-One Face Palettes

5. **Nails, Brushes & Tools**:
   - Nail Enamel & Gel Finishes
   - Foundation, Eyeshadow & Blush Brushes
   - Blending Sponges
   - Micellar Water & Bi-phase Makeup Removers

---

## 4. Top Brands & Price Range Index
MakeupKhoj indexes over 3,000 cosmetics brands. Common price ranges across indexed stores include:

- **Maybelline New York**: ₹149 - ₹1,499 (Mascara, SuperStay, Fit Me series)
- **L'Oreal Paris**: ₹199 - ₹1,899 (Infallible, Rouge Signature, True Match series)
- **Lakmé**: ₹99 - ₹1,500 (9to5, Absolute, Eyeconic, Forever Matte series)
- **Sugar Cosmetics**: ₹199 - ₹1,499 (Matte as Hell, Smudge Me Not, Contour De Force)
- **Insight Cosmetics**: ₹49 - ₹499 (Budget ultra-value range)
- **Swiss Beauty**: ₹99 - ₹799 (High value dupes and everyday essentials)
- **Colorbar**: ₹199 - ₹1,999 (Sinful Matte, Perfect Match, Velvet Matte)
- **Kay Beauty**: ₹399 - ₹1,899 (Prestige co-created formulation line)
- **M.A.C Cosmetics**: ₹1,050 - ₹4,800 (Retro Matte, Studio Fix Fluid, Prep + Prime)
- **Huda Beauty**: ₹1,250 - ₹6,500 (Empowered, Faux Filter, Liquid Matte)
- **Nykaa Cosmetics**: ₹120 - ₹1,200 (So Creme, All Day Matte, Molten Matte)
- **Plum Goodness**: ₹299 - ₹1,100 (Clean vegan beauty range)
- **REVLON**: ₹249 - ₹1,799 (ColorStay, Super Lustrous)

---

## 5. Pricing Comparison Methodology & Quality Assurance
- **Strict Variant Identification**: Products are matched across stores using brand, canonical product family name, shade name/number, and quantity.
- **Genuine Pricing Only**: Only actual checkout prices are displayed; arbitrary non-authentic MSRP inflations are discounted.
- **Store Legitimacy**: Only authentic sellers and verified marketplaces are indexed to prevent counterfeit makeup.
- **Automated Validation**: Products without images or with invalid pricing are excluded from featured directories and landing recommendations.
